slices.focus: Year of data earns partial restoration of targeted spacing
slices.summary: Lucia compiles a full year of dashboard data into a cleaner quarterly report, showing that calendars using the written backup tiers had fewer same-morning crisis calls. She leverages this to get partial targeted spacing restored on the heaviest Spanish days — conditional on quarterly delay metrics being tracked alongside it. The conversation frames this as a 'probationary foothold' rather than a final win: real progress with a leash attached. She plans to write a one-page note defining 'meaningful delay' vs 'normal courtroom variation,' keep the quarterly report format clean, and avoid pushing for more expansion until the conditional spacing proves stable.
decisions: Lucia's job structure now includes backup tiers, monthly operations review, and partially restored targeted spacing tied
